notes: Header X positions derived from dimensioned pin3 and 0.1-inch pitch; pin order checked against QRP Labs schematic.
Female socket and clearance drills are host-design choices, not manufacturer-specified QLG3 hole diameters.
11 mm spacers follow the QRP kit. Nominal fully seated standard connector stack is 8.5 + 2.54 = 11.04 mm; the 0.04 mm difference is shown, not resolved by changing standard connector geometry.
Turn QLG3 over about its X axis from Hans's drawing: E108 and SMA face up; fit the male header on the opposite face so its mating pins point down. All XY geometry is transformed consistently.
No fit or interference qualification is claimed from the provisional 3D depiction.
Connector solids copied from KiCad 10.0.6; remaining body dimensions estimated from QMX+ assembly manual rev 3.07a p61 photographs. Board thickness, module holes and screw geometry are assumptions.
Component keepouts cover the socket body plus 0.5 mm and two 7.4 mm square mounting-hardware envelopes. Tracks, vias, pads and pours remain allowed subject to normal clearances.
